acceptance: An intentional remote branch rewind to an ancestor commit can be reconciled without manual cache intervention.
A CLI or backend repair path exists to resync the local store tip with the remote branch when history is rewritten.
context: Identified during object store tip CAS design and testing (test_read_follows_a_force_pushed_branch). An ancestor rewind looks identical to a slow racing process, so advance_tip keeps the newer commit.
description: Store.advance_tip() uses compare-and-swap and skips updates if the new tip is an ancestor of the current tip (self.is_ancestor(new, current)), to protect against slow concurrent readers writing stale older tips backwards. However, if an administrator or maintainer intentionally force-pushes an ancestor rewind to the remote branch, the local store tip remains on the newer orphaned commit permanently, serving it offline. An explicit force-sync or remote-divergence reconciliation command is needed if rewinds ever occur.
